android.desc: Collect, save, and order easily with your REWE app. Whether you're collecting and redeeming euros with our REWE Bonus benefits program, saving even more with current offers in your store, collecting loyalty points, paying securely with a scan, receiving your digital receipt, or discovering delicious recipe ideas: With your REWE app, you always have all your benefits at your fingertips – and you can even conveniently order with REWE's delivery or pickup service. Get the REWE app now and secure all the benefits! ► Collect, redeem, and save euros with REWE Bonus ► Always keep an eye on all supermarket offers in your REWE store ► Easily plan your shopping with your shopping list ► Collect loyalty points and secure rewards ► Pay securely with REWE Pay ► Receive your digital receipt with the REWE eBon ► Enjoy all the benefits with just one scan while shopping ► Conveniently order groceries online or have them delivered ► Discover over 7,000 recipes to try REWE Bonus: Collect euros in the REWE app! REWE Bonus is the new benefits program in your REWE app that rewards your purchases individually: with bonus credit in euros. Simply collect, redeem as you like, and save! Current brochures and offers With our weekly offers and brochures, you can save even more money while shopping. Discover a wide selection of offers for products such as fresh fruit and vegetables, meat and sausage products, cheese, desserts, dairy products, frozen foods, and much more – perfect for your weekly shop or a picnic. Activate push notifications so you don't miss a discount! Create a shopping list Forget your paper shopping list! From now on, conveniently create a digital shopping list with your REWE app and shop even more relaxed. You can also create the shopping list using voice input. Your rewards with digital loyalty points Simply practical: With the REWE app, you can now collect and redeem our loyalty points digitally. This way, you always have your collection booklet with you and find all the information about current promotions with just one click. Pay securely with one scan Save time and pay conveniently with REWE Pay! After activation, scan your REWE app at the checkout, and your payment will be processed automatically.
